name: Xinjiang Xintai Natural Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Xintai Natural Gas Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, transmits, distributes, sells, and installs natural gas in China. It operates through three segments: City Gas and Natural Gas Extraction and Sales; Coalbed Methane; and Other. The company engages in the home installation of natural gas; exploration, development, and production of coalbed methane and conventional oil and gas; and operation of pipelines and gas stations.
